title: FETALFusion: Resolution-Aware State-Space Modeling for Multi-Domain Fetal Head Segmentation
abstract: arXiv:2610.17951v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Head circumference (HC) measured from 2D ultrasound is a routine marker of fetal growth, and automating it needs segmentations whose boundaries hold up on individual scans, not only on average. We present FETALFusion, a dual-path CNN-Mamba encoder-decoder for fetal head segmentation across acquisition types. It applies four-directional state-space scans only at the two highest-resolution stages, routes bottleneck features through domain-specific channel gates that are averaged at test time, and adds a weak landmark shape prior. We train jointly on transabdominal (HC-18) and transperineal (PSFHS) images and compare ten methods on a held-out test set of 471 images, each trained under one schedule and scored by surface distances at native resolution. FETALFusion reaches a Dice score of 0.963 and an HD95 of 2.10 mm without test-time augmentation or a domain label. It improves on U-Mamba on all five reported metrics (HD95 reduced by 0.31 mm

translated_title: FETALFusion：面向多域胎儿头部分割的分辨率感知状态空间建模
translated_abstract: 从2D超声测量的头围（HC）是胎儿生长的常规监测指标，实现其自动化需要分割边界在单个扫描上也能保持精确，而不仅仅是在平均意义上表现良好。我们提出了FETALFusion，一种用于跨采集类型胎儿头部分割的双路径CNN-Mamba编码器-解码器。该方法仅在两个最高分辨率阶段应用四方向状态空间扫描，通过领域特定的通道门控路由瓶颈特征（测试时取平均），并引入弱标志点形状先验。我们在经腹（HC-18）和经会阴（PSFHS）图像上联合训练，并在471张图像的保留测试集上与十种方法进行比较，所有方法均在同一调度下训练，并以原始分辨率的表面距离进行评分。在不使用测试时增强或领域标签的情况下，FETALFusion达到了0.963的Dice分数和2.10 mm的HD95，在所有五项报告指标上均优于U-Mamba（HD95降低了0.31 mm）。
tldr: FETALFusion提出了一种双路径CNN-Mamba架构，通过仅在最高分辨率阶段进行四方向状态空间扫描、领域特定通道门控融合及弱标志点形状先验，实现了跨经腹与经会阴超声的胎儿头部精确分割，Dice达0.963、HD95仅2.10 mm。
en_tdlr: FETALFusion is a dual-path CNN-Mamba encoder-decoder that applies four-directional state-space scans only at the highest-resolution stages, domain-specific channel gating averaged at test time, and a weak landmark shape prior, achieving state-of-the-art multi-domain fetal head segmentation with Dice 0.963 and HD95 of 2.10 mm.
